title: Splitting the sign cube by coordinates
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a subset $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$ is equivalent to the product of sign assignments on $J$ and sign assignments on its complement in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$.
